factories.locationNote: Outline = the ATCF construction site east of the Giga Texas vehicle factory, south of Tesla Road (OpenStreetMap way 1553482280). Cross-checked against Sentinel-2: the rectangle is cleared by late May 2026, a bevel-cornered foundation appears by early July and slab work by late September — matching drone reports (Joe Tegtmeyer via Tom's Hardware) of a rectangular foundation extending south with beveled corners. Tesla's TDLR filing (TABS2026028764, 'Austin Semiconductor Fab') lists a 489,600 sq ft building. Base map imagery predates construction.

factories.aka: Tesla × SpaceX chip production complex (Gibbons Creek, ex-coal plant site)
factories.location: Grimes County, TX (SE of Gibbons Creek Reservoir, ~20 mi E of College Station)
factories.area: ~555 acres cleared for phase 1 (Sep 2026) · 22,429-acre JETI project boundary · up to 100M sq ft planned

extras.Construction start: Land clearing since early Jul 2026 (Sentinel-2, 07-09); formal start 2026-12-01 (Texas filing)
extras.Site: Decommissioned Gibbons Creek coal plant, existing water storage

factories._progressNote: Site prep only: land clearing SE of Gibbons Creek Reservoir, first visible in Sentinel-2 on 2026-07-09 (~16 acres) and growing to ~155 acres by 07-31 and ~520 acres by 09-22 — a month before the first press report (KBTX 2026-08-11; fire dept confirmed it is the Terafab site). Vertical construction is filed to start 2026-12-01, so progress is a nominal 2%.

factories.locationNote: Outline = phase-1 land clearing measured from Sentinel-2 on 2026-09-22 (~555 acres; a separate ~60-acre pad sits just south). It falls inside the area mapped as 'Terafab' on OpenStreetMap from drone footage and inside the 22,429-acre JETI project boundary SpaceX filed with the Texas Comptroller, and matches drone reports of phase 1 (of up to 10) on the western side of the site near Gibbons Creek Reservoir (Joe Tegtmeyer, 2026-08-23). SpaceX hasn't published building footprints; the outline will grow as clearing continues. Base map imagery predates the clearing.
